units: <cite ref="Moed Katan 28a:2">M. Kat. 28ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Numbers 20:1">Num. XX, 1</cite>) <he>סמוך למיתה ק׳</he> immediately after death, burial is mentioned (without mentioning the exhibition of the body in an open place prior to burial).

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 46b:9">Snh. 46ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 21:23">Deut. XXI, 23</cite>) <he>מכאן רמז לק׳ וכ׳</he> here is a hint in the Torah that burying the dead is a religious duty.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 4:5:14">Y. Taan. IV, 69ᵃ</cite> top <he>משניתנו … לק׳</he> when those slain at Bethar were permitted to be buried; <cite ref="Berakhot 48b">Ber. 48ᵇ</cite>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 62">Gen. R. s. 62</cite> <he>מקְבוּרָתָהּ … לקְבוּרָתוֹ וכ׳</he> thirty-eight years intervened between Sarah’s funeral and that of Abraham; a. fr.—
Targ. Y. II, Deut. XXXIII, 21 בית ק׳ cemetery
